sms: Start pivot today. Flash drought risk 14% next 7 days, 5x normal (3%). Soil 39th %ile D0. Avg save $4.9/acre, $85/acre if it hits.
note: Verdict: start the pivot today. Risk next 7 days is 14%, vs 3% normal - 5 times normal. Soil is 39th percentile and D0 abnormally dry. Risk stays 8% in days 8-14. Waiting 2 days for next forecast still saves $4.0 per acre on average vs usual, but starting today saves $4.9. If flash drought hits, a week's warning saves $85 per acre. What would change it: lower risk or wetter soil at next forecast.

status.how_to_read: value_* are average dollars per acre against starting the pivot the usual way (after the crop shows stress); negative means starting today costs more in pumping than it saves on average. The loss avoided is what a week's warning saves if a flash drought does come.
